modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On June 30, 2019: Donald Trump becomes the first sitting US President to visit the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea).
On June 30, 1908: The Tunguska Event, the largest impact event on Earth in human recorded history, resulting in a massive explosion over Eastern Siberia.

image_credit.author: Leonid Kulik, the expedition to the Tunguska event

did_you_know.fact: On June 30, 1886: The first transcontinental train trip across Canada departs from Montreal, Quebec. It arrives in Port Moody, British Columbia on July 4.
June 30 is observed as Teachers' Day (Dominican Republic).
On June 30, 1905: Albert Einstein sends the article On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies, in which he introduces special relativity, for publication in Annalen der Physik.
